# crosswork_data_gateway_pools (Data Source)

This data source can read a pool of Crosswork Data Gateway instances by its name or its id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_data_gateway_pools" "example" {
  name = "cw-dg-pool-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the pool; set either this or `name`
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `name` (String) Name of the pool; set either this or `id`

### Read-Only

- `data_gateway_ids` (List of String) Ids of the data gateways of the pool, in the order of the virtual IPs; the gateways are named `<pool name>-<n>`
- `description` (String) Description of the pool
- `instances` (List of String) Ids of the data gateway instances of the pool
- `prefix_length` (Number) Prefix length of the virtual IP addresses
- `protection_status` (String) High availability status of the pool, such as `PROTECTED`, `NOT_PROTECTED` or `NOT_PLANNED`
- `spares` (Number) Number of spare instances of the pool
- `virtual_ips` (List of String) Virtual IP addresses of the pool, in the order of its data gateways
